editorial.copyrightPolicy: Publisher and trip-report article text is never copied; Swoon'd writes its own explanation and links to the original. Agency media is linked with credit, not assumed redistributable.

masteryModel.usefulCompetenceStatement: Can follow her trail talk, sanity-check a day's plan for time, weather and water, and ask a real follow-up question, without pretending to be an expert or a safety authority.

licensingConstraints.constraint: Original illustrations and procedural diagrams only at launch; NPS/USGS images only after per-image credit review; no AllTrails, Gaia or onX imagery.
Brand, agency and trail-emblem names as text only; AT/PCT/CDT emblems and retailer logos are not reproduced; Leave No Trace and Ten Essentials credited descriptively.

NWS custom User-Agent; NPS API key and 1,000 requests/hour default; RIDB 50 requests/minute; AirNow attribution; USGS credit; OSM ODbL attribution. No unofficial or reverse-engineered AllTrails API; AllTrails is deep-link only.
Never copy publisher, trip-report or outdoor-publication text; explain in our own words and link.
No audio at launch; any bird or weather audio requires original or licensed recordings with a license id.
Map data: USGS public domain (credit); OSM under ODbL. The Unity sim uses synthetic terrain and no real place names.

safetyConstraints: Swoon'd teaches appreciation and understanding, not safety training; it is no substitute for wilderness first aid, navigation, avalanche or swiftwater training, or local ranger guidance.
Every decision-scenario carries a safetyNote and never asserts that a route, crossing, time or condition is safe; the conservative option is always the best answer when risk rises.
Never imply a scenario or the Contour Flyover sim replaces real-world navigation or survival skills; the sim uses synthetic terrain.

No gamified pressure on hazards: no timers, streak bonuses or speed rewards on lightning, flood, crossing, wildlife, altitude, heat, snow or lost-hiker scenarios; no mileage, elevation or summit leaderboards.
Live conditions are informational only; always show source and age and link to the official land manager or agency.
No medical procedures beyond recognition and descend-or-seek-help; wildlife guidance is principles only and defers to local rangers; avalanche content is awareness only.
Safety-critical lessons are reviewed by a qualified reviewer (e.g. Wilderness First Responder and Leave No Trace trainer) before release.
